addChooser.title: Add music
addChooser.subtitle: Several ways in. All of them put the music onto this phone.
addChooser.linkHint: A YouTube or Bilibili link you already have.
addChooser.searchHint: Find something by name, then pick a result to add it.
addChooser.localHint: Pick music you already have in your storage. Nothing is downloaded.
addChooser.importHint: Bring in a Spotify or YouTube playlist. You review the matches before anything downloads.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search for something to add to your library, then pick a result to download it.
search.placeholder: Search for a song, artist, or video...
search.rateLimited: This source is limiting requests right now. Wait a moment and search again.

searchSource.title: Where to find music
searchSource.intro: Which site MiO searches when it looks for a song — for the Search tab and for every playlist import.
searchSource.chinaHint: YouTube is not reachable from mainland China without a VPN. If that is you, choose Bilibili — MiO will search and download from there instead.
searchSource.bilibiliNote: Bilibili is paced at about one search a second, so a long playlist takes a little longer to match.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tourDescription: Replay the quick introduction to MiO.
settings.normalizeLoudnessHint: Play every track at a similar level, so a loud song does not jump out after a quiet one.
settings.notificationsDenied: Notifications are turned off for MiO, so Android hides the player from your lock screen and notification shade. Turn them on to get the controls back.
settings.machineTranslated: Translated by machine. It may read oddly in places, or be wrong — corrections are welcome.
settings.privacyDescription: MiO keeps your library on this device. The policy explains what the app contacts, and what it never sends.
settings.copyLibraryDescription: Save your library to a file you can move to another phone, or keep as a backup. It is a one-time copy — later changes on either phone will not reach the other.
settings.libraryCopiedSkipped: Saved {{songs}}. {{skipped}} were left out: they are files you added from this phone, so another device cannot fetch them.
settings.importLibraryConfirm: {{songs}} in this copy, saved {{date}}. Downloading them will take a while and use data.
settings.importNotALibrary: That is not a MiO library file.
settings.importTooNew: That copy was made by a newer version of MiO. Update the app first.
settings.importEmpty: That copy has no songs in it.

accessKey.title: Access key
accessKey.description: If this server requires an access key to import, paste it here. It's stored only on this device.
accessKey.present: A key is saved on this device.
accessKey.absent: No key on this device. You can browse and play, but search and import are locked.

locked.title: Importing is locked
locked.description: This server requires an access key to import. Enter the key you were given to unlock it on this device.

welcome.title: Welcome to MiO
welcome.body: MiO is your personal, local-first music library. Here's a quick tour.

listen.title: Your library & player
listen.body: Everything you add lands in your Library, ready to play with a queue, shuffle and repeat.

gestures.title: Shortcuts worth knowing
gestures.body: Swipe a song right to add it to your queue, and swipe left on a queued song to remove it. Long-press any song to open its menu, or hold and drag the handle to reorder a playlist.

add.title: Add music your way
add.body: Paste a link on the Add page, or search right inside the app and add results with one click.

personalize.title: Import & make it yours
personalize.body: Bring in Spotify playlists from the Import page, and pick your theme, accent colour and language in Settings.

library.empty: Your library is empty — add a link to get started.
library.emptyHint: Songs you import will show up here.
library.needKeyHint: Add a link to your first song. Searching and importing playlists need an invite key; adding a link does not.
library.swipeHint: Tip: swipe a song right to add it to your queue.

song.deleteMessage: Delete "{{title}}"? This removes it from this device, along with the downloaded file.
song.notDownloaded: Not downloaded — tap to get it

playlists.empty: No playlists yet — create one above.
playlists.deleteMessage: Delete the playlist "{{name}}"? The songs themselves stay.
playlists.emptyHint: Playlists you create or import appear here.
playlists.addTracksFailed: The playlist was created, but the songs couldn't be added.

playlistDetail.empty: This playlist is empty. Add songs from the <library>library</library>.
playlistDetail.emptyHint: Long-press a song anywhere in MiO to add it here.
playlistDetail.editHint: Tap to select. Hold a row to drag it.
playlistDetail.noMatches: No songs in this playlist match "{{query}}".

addLink.title: Add a link
addLink.description: Paste a link from YouTube, Bilibili, or any other supported site. The audio is downloaded, converted and tagged in the background.
addLink.onDeviceHint: Fetches the audio straight to your phone, without the server. YouTube and Bilibili links.
addLink.unsupportedSite: This phone can fetch from YouTube and Bilibili. It cannot read that link.

localAdd.title: Files on this phone
localAdd.description: Pick music that is already in your storage and add it to your library. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is sent anywhere.
localAdd.copiedHint: Files are copied into MiO, so your originals stay exactly where they are. Titles are read from the files themselves where they have them.

player.sleepSetEndOfTrack: Stopping at the end of this track

playback.title: Playback
playback.crossfadeDescription: Blend the end of each track into the start of the next, instead of cutting between them.

equalizer.title: Equalizer
equalizer.normalizeDescription: Play every track at a similar volume, using a measurement taken when it was imported.
equalizer.unsupportedBody: The equaliser needs Android 9 or newer, and an app build that includes it. Everything else plays as normal.
equalizer.notReachingBody: These settings are saved, but the player has not accepted them, so the sound is unchanged. It needs an app build that includes the equaliser.
equalizer.monoHint: Both channels play the same sum. For listening with one earbud, or when the ears differ — nothing is lost, and anything mixed to one side is now in both.

worker.waiting: Still waiting for a worker to pick this up. If this doesn't start shortly, check that the worker process is running.

importDetail.title: Importing "{{name}}"
importDetail.reviewHint: Matching finished — accept, reject or change matches below, then confirm to start downloading. Nothing is downloaded until you confirm.
importDetail.keepScreenOpen: Keep this screen open. Android pauses downloads when the app is minimised, and the import will carry on from where it stopped next time you open it.
importDetail.pausedWhileAway: The import paused while MiO was in the background. Keep this screen open while it runs.
importDetail.deviceSaveFailed_one: {{count}} song couldn't be saved to this device. Open this import again to retry.
importDetail.deviceSaveFailed_other: {{count}} songs couldn't be saved to this device. Open this import again to retry.
importDetail.failedHint_one: {{count}} track failed to download. Most failures are temporary — trying again usually works.
importDetail.failedHint_other: {{count}} tracks failed to download. Most failures are temporary — trying again usually works.
importDetail.failedSoFar_one: {{count}} track couldn't be fetched so far. The rest are still coming.
importDetail.failedSoFar_other: {{count}} tracks couldn't be fetched so far. The rest are still coming.
importDetail.gaveUp: Stopped after several failures in a row. Open this import again to carry on.
importDetail.alreadyHere_one: {{count}} track was already on this device, so this run has nothing to do for it.
importDetail.alreadyHere_other: {{count}} tracks were already on this device, so this run has nothing to do for them.
importDetail.duplicates_one: {{count}} track was the same video as another, so the playlist holds it once.
importDetail.duplicates_other: {{count}} tracks were the same video as others, so the playlist holds each once.
importDetail.sourceRefused: {{source}} has stopped answering searches from this connection — it does that after a burst, and it usually clears in about fifteen minutes. Matching has paused. The tracks it did not reach are still waiting, so open this import again later and it will carry on from here.
importDetail.noneSaved: Nothing was saved. Every track this run attempted failed, so the playlist is empty.

importNotification.title: Importing your playlist
importNotification.body: Downloading "{{name}}" — you can leave this screen.

youtubeImport.title: Import a YouTube playlist
youtubeImport.description: Paste a public YouTube playlist URL. Its videos are listed, then downloaded once you confirm — no account needed.
youtubeImport.privateHint: Only you can see a private playlist, so MiO can't read it. In YouTube, change that playlist's privacy to Unlisted — it stays out of search and off your channel — then paste its link above and import it like any other. Watch Later is the one list this doesn't work for.

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.notConfigured: Spotify import isn't set up on this server. Add SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID to backend/.env and restart the backend — see docs/adr/0005-spotify-playlist-import.md.
spotify.noAccount: No account connected yet. You'll sign in on Spotify's own page — MiO never sees your password, only permission to read your playlists and Liked Songs.
spotify.disconnectMessage: Disconnect "{{name}}"? Anything already imported stays in the library.
spotify.notConfiguredShort: Spotify import isn't set up on this server, so there's nothing to connect to yet.

error.access_denied: You cancelled the Spotify sign-in, so nothing was connected.
error.state_mismatch: That sign-in expired before it finished. Try connecting again.
error.exchange_failed: Spotify wouldn't finish the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: Connecting to Spotify didn't work. Try again.

google.title: Private YouTube playlists
google.notConfiguredShort: Private playlist import isn't set up on this server, so there's nothing to connect to yet.
google.noAccount: Connect your YouTube account to import playlists only you can see. You'll sign in on Google's own page — MiO never sees your password, only permission to read your playlists.
google.disconnectMessage: Disconnect "{{name}}"? Anything already imported stays on this device.
google.expiry: Google signs MiO out about once a week, because the app is unverified. When it happens you'll be asked to connect again — it takes a few seconds, and nothing you've already imported is affected.

error.access_denied: You cancelled the Google sign-in, so nothing was connected.
error.state_mismatch: That sign-in expired before it finished. Try connecting again.
error.exchange_failed: Google wouldn't finish the sign-in. If your Google account has no YouTube channel yet, create one first — the channel is what holds the playlists.
error.unknown: Connecting to YouTube didn't work. Try again.

failure.reauth: MiO's connection to your YouTube account has expired. Google does this about once a week while the app is unverified — connect again and carry on where you left off.
failure.quota: MiO has used up today's YouTube allowance. It resets once a day, at midnight Pacific time. Nothing is broken and nothing is lost.
failure.unconfigured: Private playlist import isn't set up on this server.
failure.locked: This server needs an access key before it will read your playlists. Add yours in Settings.
failure.notConnected: No YouTube account is connected any more. Connect one to import from it.
failure.offline: Couldn't reach your MiO server. Check the connection and try again.

matchReview.repointedToast: Source changed — now tap the “Try the tracks that failed” button

importPage.title: Import playlists
importPage.description: Connect a Spotify account to bring its playlists and Liked Songs into your library. Spotify only provides the track list — the audio itself is found and downloaded from YouTube.
importPage.deleteMessage: Delete the import record for "{{name}}"? The songs and playlist it created stay.

errors.accessDenied: Spotify access was declined — nothing was connected.
errors.stateMismatch: That sign-in attempt had expired — try connecting again.
errors.exchangeFailed: Connecting to Spotify failed — try again in a moment.

queue.title: Play queue
queue.emptyUser: Nothing queued by hand. Use “Play next” or “Queue” on any song.
queue.swipeHint: Tip: swipe a queued song left to take it out.
queue.reorderHint: Hold a row to reorder it.
queue.nothingToPlay: Nothing in the queue is downloaded yet.

sleep.title: Sleep timer
sleep.activeEndOfTrack: Sleep timer: stops at the end of this track

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.emptyDescription: Tap the heart on any song to keep it here.

setup.title: Connect to your MiO
setup.intro: MiO needs no server — your music is on this phone. Connect one only if you self-host, to add links from sites this phone cannot read.
setup.introInvite: Paste the invite key you were sent. The server is already set up — you don't need an address.
setup.serverHint: Ask whoever set up the server for this.
setup.keyHint: Only needed if your server asks for one.
setup.keyHintInvite: Your key unlocks searching and importing playlists. Your music is yours either way — a key does not change what you can see.
setup.usingDefault: No server. Everything stays on this device.
setup.usingCustom: Using a server you set yourself.

errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach that address. Check the address, and that your phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the server.
errors.keyRejected: That access key wasn't accepted. Check for a typo, or ask for a new one.
errors.notAServer: Something answered, but it doesn't look like MiO. Check the address.

failure.bot_check: YouTube would not serve this video to the server. Another video usually works — this one is unlucky rather than broken.
failure.age_restricted: This video is age-restricted, so it cannot be downloaded.
failure.geo_restricted: This video is not available in the server's country.
failure.took_too_long: This took too long and was stopped. The source was slow or stopped responding — trying again usually works.
failure.rate_limited: The site is asking the server to slow down. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.network: The server could not reach the video. Try again.
failure.unsupported: MiO cannot import from that link.
failure.drm: This content is copy-protected and cannot be downloaded.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: MiO hit a problem and had to stop what it was doing. A report has been sent automatically.
crash.placeholder: I pressed play on the second song and it froze...

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.settingsHint: A log of what the app has been doing, kept on this device.
diagnostics.description: Newest first. This is what the app recorded — imports, playback and requests that failed. It stays on this device; copy or share it if you are reporting a problem.
diagnostics.pageDescription: What the clients reported — crashes, and the daily log the Android app uploads. Newest first.
diagnostics.emptyHint: Nothing has been reported at this level. The Android app uploads its log once a day.
diagnostics.adminOnlyHint: These are every user's reports. Enter an administrator key in Settings to read them — an ordinary access key is not enough.
diagnostics.noServer: No server — everything stays on this device.
diagnostics.rangeProbeHint: Paste a YouTube link to test whether downloads can be resumed. Developer diagnostic; the result goes in the log below.
diagnostics.copied: Report copied. Paste it wherever you are reporting the problem.
diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy. Try Share instead.

deviceAdds.heading: Added from here
deviceAdds.slow: This can take a few minutes — each source is tried in turn.
deviceAdds.interrupted: Interrupted — the app closed before it finished
deviceAdds.unavailable: {{source}} will not play this one here — it may be private, removed, or blocked in your country. Another source may work.

failureKind.timed_out: Ran out of time — the connection was slow. Worth trying again.
failureKind.refused: The source refused the download. Another source may work.
failureKind.refused_at_start: {{source}} refused the download before sending anything. It has cleared on its own every time so far — try again in a few minutes.
failureKind.unavailable: {{source}} will not play this one here — it may be private, removed, or blocked in your country.
failureKind.no_source: No source could provide the audio.
failureKind.cleartext: The source offered an insecure link, which this phone refused to open. Try again — the next attempt usually gets a secure one.
failureKind.offline: No connection. Check your network and try again.
failureKind.device: This phone could not save it — it may be out of space.
failureKind.unknown: It did not finish, and the reason is not one MiO recognises.

bilibiliFav.title: Bilibili favourites
bilibiliFav.intro: Sign in to import your own favourites folders. Your folders are private by default, so this needs a sign-in — a public folder does not.
bilibiliFav.scanHint: Open Bilibili on your phone, tap the scan button, and confirm the sign-in.
bilibiliFav.scanned: Scanned — confirm it in the Bilibili app.
bilibiliFav.noFolders: No favourites folders on this account.
bilibiliFav.signedOut: Your Bilibili sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
bilibiliFav.credentialNote: MiO stores only the session cookie, on this phone. It is never sent to the server and never appears in diagnostics.
bilibiliFav.skipped_one: {{count}} entry in this folder is no longer available on Bilibili.
bilibiliFav.skipped_other: {{count}} entries in this folder are no longer available on Bilibili.
bilibiliFav.importFailed: Could not read that folder. Your sign-in may have expired.

netease.title: NetEase Cloud Music
netease.intro: Import a playlist by link. No account needed — the playlist is read on this phone.
netease.description: Paste a NetEase Cloud Music playlist link. Its tracks are read on this phone, then each one is searched for on {{source}} — you review the matches before anything downloads.
netease.publicHint: The playlist must be public. MiO reads it without signing in, so a private 歌单 — including 我喜欢的音乐, which is private by default — cannot be read. In NetEase, open the playlist, edit it, and set it to public.
netease.notALink: That is not a NetEase playlist link. Paste a link from music.163.com, or paste the playlist's number on its own.
netease.idHint: No link to hand? Paste the playlist's number instead — the digits after id= in its address.
netease.refused: NetEase would not answer ({{code}}). The playlist may be private or deleted — if not, try again in a few minutes.
netease.truncated: Only {{received}} of {{expected}} tracks could be read. Nothing was imported, so try again rather than ending up with half a playlist.
netease.audioNote: MiO never downloads audio from NetEase. It reads the track list only; the audio comes from {{source}}, exactly as it does for a Spotify import.

kugou.title: Kugou
kugou.intro: Import a 歌单 by link. No account needed — the playlist is read on this phone.
kugou.description: Paste a Kugou playlist link. Its tracks are read on this phone, then each one is searched for on {{source}} — you review the matches before anything downloads.
kugou.publicHint: The 歌单 must be public. MiO reads it without signing in, so a private playlist cannot be read. In Kugou, open the 歌单, edit it, and set it to public.
kugou.splitHint: Kugou stores the artist and the title in one field, so a few tracks may come through with no artist. Those are sent to the review step rather than matched automatically.
kugou.notALink: That is not a Kugou playlist link. Paste a link from kugou.com, or paste the 歌单's number on its own.
kugou.idHint: No link to hand? Paste the 歌单's number instead — the digits in special/single/… on its web page. Kugou is only available in mainland China, so its app may not offer a link at all.
kugou.refused: Kugou would not answer ({{code}}). The 歌单 may be private or deleted — if not, try again in a few minutes.
kugou.truncated: Only {{received}} of {{expected}} tracks could be read. Nothing was imported, so try again rather than ending up with half a playlist.
kugou.audioNote: MiO never downloads audio from Kugou. It reads the track list only; the audio comes from {{source}}, exactly as it does for a Spotify import.

qq.title: QQ Music
qq.intro: Import a 歌单 by link. No account needed — the playlist is read on this phone.
qq.description: Paste a QQ Music playlist link. Its tracks are read on this phone, then each one is searched for on {{source}} — you review the matches before anything downloads.
qq.publicHint: The 歌单 must be public. MiO reads it without signing in, so a private playlist cannot be read. In QQ Music, open the 歌单, edit it, and set it to public.
qq.notALink: That is not a QQ Music playlist link. Paste a link from y.qq.com or a QQ Music share, or paste the 歌单's number on its own.
qq.idHint: The QQ Music app shares only to other Tencent apps, so there may be no link to copy. Either open the 歌单 in a browser, or paste its number on its own — the digits after playlist/ or id= in its address.
qq.refused: QQ Music would not answer ({{code}}). The 歌单 may be private or deleted — if not, try again in a few minutes.
qq.truncated: Only {{received}} of {{expected}} tracks could be read. Nothing was imported, so try again rather than ending up with half a playlist.
qq.audioNote: MiO never downloads audio from QQ Music. It reads the track list only; the audio comes from {{source}}, exactly as it does for a Spotify import.

parts.intro_one: This video has {{count}} part. Choose what to import.
parts.intro_other: This video is in {{count}} parts. Choose which ones to import — everything is selected to start with.

donate.title: Enjoying MiO?
donate.body: MiO is free and always will be — nothing is locked, and there is nothing to buy. It is one student's project, and I am paying my own university tuition, so if MiO is useful to you, anything at all helps.
donate.bodyShort: MiO is free and always will be. It is one student's project — if it is useful to you, anything helps.
donate.grantsNothing: A donation unlocks nothing. Every part of MiO works exactly the same either way.

updates.title: Updates
updates.offline: Could not check just now. Your app still works.
updates.readyBody: A fix has been downloaded. Restart MiO to use it.
updates.apkBody: MiO {{version}} is ready to download. This one has to be installed by hand.
